projects.name: Claude skills
projects.tagline: Free Claude Code skills from the features we build. Each one is a tested way of working your AI can follow, and none of them publishes anything on its own.

projects.name: Startup model
projects.tagline: Work out what a small startup needs: stages, team, money in and out, and the risks, in one page that stays in your browser.

projects.name: Muntra
projects.tagline: Small, privacy-first web analytics in Go. No cookies, visitor hashes with a salt that changes every day, and bots counted apart from people.

projects.name: Browser games
projects.tagline: Small games built into the sites on Idun: bouldering, kayaking and hunting on the ice. Free to play on a phone or a computer.

projects.name: Fulla
projects.tagline: Share a password once. It is encrypted in your browser, each recipient gets their own link that shows it a single time, and then it is deleted. Self-hosted.

projects.name: faq-rag
projects.tagline: A local AI assistant for your own documents. It cites its sources, says “I don’t know” when they don’t hold the answer, and every change is measured. Runs on your own hardware.

projects.name: Idun Image Lab
projects.tagline: Make AI images on your own Mac, tuned 3× faster: 37-second drafts, then a high-res version of the one you like. Swap models freely: base, Turbo, or uncensored finetunes (not endorsed).

projects.name: Norn
projects.tagline: A small kanban board for teams: drag cards between columns, comment with @mentions, estimate time. One Node process and one SQLite file, sign-in by emailed link. Self-hosted.
